dimensionPresets.label: Compact standard
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Baseline Compact Timber 40 footprint for balanced living and bedroom proportions.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Compact standard keeps the baseline shell footprint, quantity takeoff and module allowance.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM follows the baseline compact module panel and opening schedule.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan uses the standard compact shell width and bedroom depth.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Two transport-ready compact modules in the baseline footprint.

dimensionPresets.label: Compact wide living
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Expands the living width for a more generous lounge and kitchen frontage.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Wide living preset increases measured shell width but keeps the same two-module concept pending production engineering.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes wider floor, roof and facade spans for living-zone review.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan widens the social zone while preserving the one-bedroom concept.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Two compact modules with wider living-side shell assumptions.

dimensionPresets.label: Compact long bedroom
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Stretches the private end of the compact plan to improve bedroom and storage depth.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Long bedroom preset slightly increases shell length and private-room planning allowance.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes longer floor, roof and interior partition runs for the bedroom-side module.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan lengthens the private zone and circulation allowance.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Two compact modules with elongated bedroom-side shell assumptions.

dimensionPresets.label: Family standard
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Baseline family footprint with shared living zone and two-bedroom planning.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Family standard keeps the baseline four-module planning and quantity takeoff.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM follows the baseline family module schedule.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan uses the standard family shell depth and living width.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Four baseline family modules with one shared service core.

dimensionPresets.label: Family wide living
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Adds width to the family social zone for a broader living/kitchen frontage.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Family wide living increases living-side shell width while staying within the same baseline module count.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes broader living-shell panel sizes and roof spans for review.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan allocates more width to the shared living and dining zone.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Four family modules with wider shared-living shell assumptions.

dimensionPresets.label: Family extra bedroom module
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Extends the family plan with an extra module for a larger bedroom wing or flex room.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Extra bedroom module preset raises measured area and module logistics assumptions for pre-quote discussion.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes an extra module shell, broader opening schedule and longer service runs.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan grows into a five-module concept with more bedroom/flex area.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Five-module concept; final module split and transport logic require engineering confirmation.

dimensionPresets.label: Sauna standard
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Baseline sauna cabin footprint for compact wellness and guest use.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Sauna standard keeps the baseline shell and service-core planning allowance.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM follows the baseline sauna shell and wellness-core schedule.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan uses the standard sauna shell depth and terrace-ready frontage.

dimensionPresets.label: Sauna deep terrace
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Adds depth to the wellness frontage for a deeper deck and rest transition zone.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Deep terrace preset increases measured frontage depth and terrace review allowance without changing the core transport concept.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes longer terrace interface, roof edge and deck support assumptions.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan deepens the front threshold and terrace connection.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Two-module sauna concept with deeper terrace-facing frontage assumptions.

dimensionPresets.label: Sauna guest wide
dimensionPresets.summaryNote: Widens the guest/rest side of the sauna cabin for a more comfortable overnight concept.
dimensionPresets.estimateNote: Guest wide preset increases shell width and guest-room allowance while keeping the same two-module concept.
dimensionPresets.bomNote: Preview BOM notes wider facade, floor and roof elements for guest-side review.
dimensionPresets.floorplanNote: Floorplan widens the rest/guest zone while preserving the compact wellness core.
dimensionPresets.moduleDimensionNote: Two-module sauna/guest concept with widened guest-side shell assumptions.

layoutVariants.label: Open studio
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Open studio layout prioritizes one flexible living/sleeping room with minimal partitions.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Open studio keeps interior partition scope light; furniture and privacy packages still require review.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM assumes reduced partition allowance for one-room compact planning.

layoutVariants.label: One bedroom
layoutVariants.summaryNote: One-bedroom layout separates the sleeping zone from the living/kitchen area.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: One-bedroom estimate uses the standard compact partition and door allowance.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM assumes one private bedroom partition package.

layoutVariants.label: Office cabin
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Office cabin layout adapts the private module for work, guest stays or studio use.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Office cabin estimate keeps the same module package but flags work/guest fit-out for review.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM uses the compact bedroom module as an office/guest module placeholder.

layoutVariants.label: Two bedroom
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Two-bedroom layout is the baseline family plan with a larger shared living zone.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Two-bedroom estimate uses the baseline family module and partition package.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM assumes two bedroom modules and one shared service core.

layoutVariants.label: Three-bedroom compact
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Three-bedroom compact layout converts storage/flex area into a small third room concept.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Three-bedroom compact requires partition and layout review before a production quote.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM notes extra partition planning but does not claim engineering-grade room quantities.

layoutVariants.label: Large living
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Large living layout prioritizes the shared social zone and keeps bedrooms more flexible.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Large living estimate keeps module pricing stable while layout detailing remains review-only.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM assumes the same modules with altered internal zoning notes.

layoutVariants.label: Sauna only
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Sauna-only layout focuses on wellness use with a compact changing and service zone.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Sauna-only estimate requires sauna equipment and wet-zone engineering review.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM carries sauna/wellness component notes for future production refinement.

layoutVariants.label: Guest cabin
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Guest cabin layout turns the sauna core into a small overnight/rest module concept.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Guest cabin estimate keeps sauna-cabin module pricing but flags guest fit-out for review.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM treats the wellness core as a guest/rest module placeholder.

layoutVariants.label: Sauna + rest room
layoutVariants.summaryNote: Sauna + rest room layout balances wellness use with a small lounge/rest zone.
layoutVariants.estimateNote: Sauna + rest room estimate remains preview-only pending sauna equipment specification.
layoutVariants.bomNote: Preview BOM assumes the current sauna/rest module with service core.
